picks.detail: Slalom describes moving 180 Genie agents onto a new contact-center solution. That makes it a useful first interview for a support leader who owns routing, agent training and service continuity. Ask to see the release plan for the first queue and an example of an issue the operations team could fix after handover.

Capgemini describes establishing a global automation service with ZF. A buyer funding several teams can use that case to ask who decides which workflow gets built next. Request a backlog example with the estimated effort, business owner and sign-off for a completed automation.

AY Automate publishes a workforce compliance case involving document verification for festival crews. A coordinator buying a similar service should bring an expired document, an unreadable scan and a record that needs human review. Ask the team to show the outcome for all three before pricing a rollout.

methodology: Compare the deliverable each service could produce: a scoped backlog, a working integration or a pilot your operator can accept. The directory gives you a deliverable to request from each bidder.
questions: For an assessment, ask for a prioritized backlog with an owner and a baseline for each opportunity.
For a pilot, agree on a test dataset, an acceptance threshold and the decisions a human will retain.
For a rollout, get a handover plan covering monitoring, recurring costs and incident response.
pricing: Request separate prices for discovery, implementation and ongoing support. Compare the cost of the first accepted workflow and the monthly cost to keep it running.

firms.name: AY Automate
firms.note: Builds AI automations and publishes delivery case studies. Ask for a pilot that takes one document from intake to a human-approved exception. Specify who labels the acceptance examples.

firms.name: BCG
firms.note: Combines strategy and applied AI. For a strategy purchase, request a sequenced opportunity list, one accountable sponsor per item and an explicit reason to decline the weakest item.

firms.name: IBM Consulting
firms.note: Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Before funding integration, ask for a map of the source systems and a running test against one of your representative records.

firms.name: Slalom
firms.note: Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Write down the smallest queue the team could launch. Request a cutover rehearsal and a training deliverable in the fixed scope.

firms.name: McKinsey QuantumBlack
firms.note: Describes a hybrid intelligence approach. Request an operating-model design that names the decision owner and shows how a disputed model output is reviewed.

firms.name: Accenture
firms.note: Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Separate the statement of work into discovery, build and rollout. Mark which deliverable releases each payment.

firms.name: Deloitte
firms.note: Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Specify which dataset must be usable at the end of engineering discovery. Ask for quality checks your engineer can repeat.

firms.name: Capgemini
firms.note: Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. For a shared process service, request a backlog intake exercise with two departments competing for the same delivery capacity.

firms.name: WeAreBrain
firms.note: Offers workflow automation and integration. If the service connects an ERP to another system, ask for one failed transaction to be replayed safely before acceptance.

firms.name: Goodspeed
firms.note: Describes n8n workflows and AI agents for operations teams. Ask for a working automation and a handover exercise. Price employee time spent learning the workflow as a buyer contribution.
